title: Increasing LLM Coding Capabilities through Synthetic Data
description: Research paper demonstrating how diverse synthetic data can enhance LLM coding capabilities. The study produced nearly 800k instruction-reasoning-code-test quadruplets to improve model performance on coding tasks.
author: Research Community

title: 2025 LLM Year in Review
description: Andrej Karpathy's comprehensive annual review highlighting major LLM developments including Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), the Software 3.0 paradigm where English instructions become the new programming interface, and LLM-assisted coding evolution. He reports relying 80% on AI Agents for programming, describing it as the biggest workflow change in 20 years of career.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: August 2025 Newsletter: GPT-5 and Model Releases
description: Simon Willison's monthly sponsors-only newsletter covering significant developments in August including GPT-5, OpenAI's open models (gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b), image editing models (Qwen-Image-Edit and Gemini Nano Banana), prompt injection developments, and current tools he's using.
author: Simon Willison

title: Replit's AI Coding Platform Evolution
description: Amjad Masad leads Replit, a multi-billion dollar AI coding platform with 34 million users. The platform enables building applications in 60 seconds through 'vibe coding' and AI agents that respond to natural language. The company focuses on unleashing 1 billion software creators through AI-powered development tools.
author: Amjad Masad

title: Hype and Reality of the AI Coding Shift
description: Software Engineering Daily podcast episode covering how AI coding tools have evolved from novelty to core infrastructure in under three years. Discusses the practical realities and separating signal from noise regarding AI and developer productivity claims.
author: Software Engineering Daily

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Development
description: Fireship covers the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a significant development in AI coding that enables better integration between AI assistants and development tools. MCP represents progress in standardized interfaces for AI-assisted coding.
author: Fireship

title: The Dangerous Illusion of AI Coding Skills
description: Two Minute Papers discusses the dangerous illusion of AI coding skills, examining whether AI coding assistants are truly making developers more productive or just creating an illusion of competence. Raises important questions about the long-term impact on developer skill development.
author: Two Minute Papers

title: AI Coding Tools: Mixed Impact Assessment
description: Hacker News discussions reveal AI coding tools can act as large accelerators but require proper workflow integration. Some reports suggest teams may be 76% faster with AI tools but with 100% more bugs. Concerns about accumulating technical debt rather than true productivity gains. The consensus suggests effectiveness depends heavily on proper integration and human oversight.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Code Generation Survey with LLM-based Agents
description: ArXiv paper 'A Survey on Code Generation with LLM-based Agents' explores how LLM-powered code generation agents are revolutionizing software development. The paper provides comprehensive analysis of the state-of-the-art in AI-assisted coding.
author: Research Community

title: Terminal-Based AI Tools Emerging
description: AI coding tools are shifting beyond traditional code editors to terminal interfaces, representing a new frontier for AI-powered development. This trend moves past tools like Cursor, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot, bringing AI capabilities directly to the command line.
author: TechCrunch
